text: Sir, kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ke is project ke liye aap ka budget kitna hai? Main aap ke budget aur requirements ke mutabiq best solution suggest kar dunga
Assalam o Alaikum, main websites aur AI chatbots banata hoon. Aap ke restaurant ke liye website + WhatsApp AI assistant bana sakta hoon jo customers ko 24/7 reply kare.
Website development 15,000 PKR se start hoti hai. Ismein complete responsive design, SEO aur WhatsApp integration shamil hai.
Theek hai, agar aapko kisi bhi tarah ki madad ya information chahiye ho toh bataiye, main yahan hoon apki madad ke liye. Aap kis tarah ki project ke liye soch rahe hain?
